items.text: The May24th 2020 update is going live to all platforms today. If you missed all the new features coming to this version you can find the detailed overview in this thread but I have pointed out the new features with images to this post as well.
If you find any errors or problems platfromwise please report to this or any other threads so I can investigate and fix that for the next update!
Hey Everybody,

Finally 0.9.3 update is for for Train Station Simulator. This new update is only available for PC / Windows right now. With your help I need to sort out errors and bugs before I upload the MAC and Linux versions as well.
Let me show all the added new features one by one with the images:

I have enabled train interiors for most of the train carriages (except for a few ones). In this update you will not see passengers sitting in the train carriages it will be added later on and some interior changes will come as well. But feel free to test the game and see what each of the trains look inside. Here is a few screenshots:

Many more new freight train types have been added. With some new cool looking engines and also the addition of new carriages. The new type of goods will be added to a latest update to your freight station and it will generate different amounts of revenue. This will result more fun of the freight option of the game. See a screenshot of one of the new trains:

Moreover not just new trains and engines will appear but players will be able to create a more complex freight termina. Right now I only enabled the new buildings for a look and overview but the freight terminal will be more detailed by time. New train types also appear on your freight train track time to time.

The zoning option for cleaning stuff is almost ready. I can show you a screenshot what it is like in the game. Unfortunately it is not working yet properly, hopefully in the upcoming weeks I can finalize this function as well. New zonings will look pretty nice.

There is a new VIP Shop a Jewelry shop. You can influence your VIP passengers with these new VIP only facilities. Your VIP passengers might feel more comfortable and happy if they see greater shops for their needs. The antique VIP carraige is not yet finished but will come in the upcoming weeks as well. Jewelry shop is available in 1980-2010 years.
Now you can place a much larger Restaurant area to your station with a larger variety of food types. Check it out. Available in 1990-2010 years.
A new larger food truck is available to your station as well.

I have managed to fix a few bugs. There was a major problems with the UI not in place in some versions of the game. It seems to be fixed now, but multi monitor setup might have some more problems still. I will look into those problems in the new updates as well.
I have also managed to fix a few object related error, issues not placing benches properly.
That is for now with this update if you find any problems please report it in the thread or in the community session of Train Station Simulator.
I continue improving this update next week so I can release it on the PUBLIC BRANCH as well as soon as possible. Moreover to Mac and Linux users.
Train Station Simulator Team

Hey Guys,
Thank you guys for all your support in the past year and I really appreciate all the active users being with the community and every new players of Train Station Simulator.
Train Station Simulator has been in Early Access for a little more than 1 year now and I have enabled lots of new features during this time.

notes.title: 1. "Where the hell is the latest update? I have waited so long!"

items.text: You might have realized that the last update of the game (especially on PC and Linux) was in Autumn and I have promised a huge update that should have arrived during 2018. Unfortunately I could not finish up all features and find all the solutions for problems in time that is why this
update is being delayed.

The game is actively developed every day but the main reason this new update takes so much time to be completed is more technical related. Train Station Simulator is being developed using a third party game developer engine. This engine got a very large new update during the time of the development of TSS. Right now the old version is still works but I decided to migrate the game to the new version of this engine and I bumped into a few serious issues during this work. The game works more or less but the code needed enormously big re-designing even to be able to work the same way as it did before this update.
Right now the main sections of the re-code is finished but still I find some nasty bugs every other day with testing.
I cannot tell an exact date when the migration will be finished and all the new features will also be ready but I am on it and doing as much as I can to release the new update.
I plan to finalize Train Station Simulator in 2019 so a first 1.0 version might come to Steam during 2019 with some more features added during this year.

I plan to continue support for the game and adding regular bug fixes, optimizations and new features upon your requests and ideas. I really need community feedback to decide which features would be the mostly wanted for the game in the future.

Thank you for your continued support and sorry for the recent delays. All these delays are for the benefits of the game so no time wasted during this time. Hopefully the 0.9 update is arriving soon and we can together with the community continue planning new features for your favorite Builder Simulator game in Train Station Simulator!

Hey Guys,

Thank you for all your continued support for Train Station Simulator. As we are approaching the first year anniversary of the early access release of Train Station Simulator we thought it is high time to give a few more details on the upcoming features we have been hard working on in the past months.

notes.title: 10. Train cleaner units, track maintenance service members

items.text: ***THE MEGA-GIGA BIG PLANNED EXTRA!!***

Due to some technical difficulties we decided to re-code from ground the complete game. It means that most of bases will be crated again but we will use existing parts of the code to avoid interruption of your existing creations. AI will be modified in some places so passengers and staff members will get more clever by time.

In 0.9 version we plan to enable the custom timetable system. I means you will have a complete control on arrival and departures of the trains with the standard minimum 3 hours limit to stay at the station per train but you will be able to have all train at once to have rush hour maximums or mid day empty tracks. Moreover we leave the basic timetable in place but there will be a separate menu to enable custom timetable.

We also plan to enable a new cool features so within a few game parameter limits you will be able to set the train carriage number and even the train types. However some limitations stays in place for example you cannot have a modern ICE looking train in the very early years. Moreover we leave the basic timetable in place but there will be a separate menu to enable custom train lengths and type.

0.9 will contain a few more extremely interesting features such as the train disasters... A derailed train? A passengers on the track? Or just a tree on the rails? Who know what other amazing disasters can happen in a station's life :)

Well... ticket gates is a huge request from our great fans. At the moment the ticket gate system is not working properly and it creates more stress and madness in the station than advantages. It really needs more work to work properly. (We know that we are saying this for sometime now but believe us: it is not yet ready to be released! :) )
We will add a few more passenger types: smoking violators and distracted passengers.
A few new trains are coming to Train Station Simulator 0.9. Each era will get one new train type so 5
We will enable a new text Localization: Brazilian - Portuguese
In version 0.9 playgrounds and parks are coming as new recreational zones.

notes.title: 10. Train cleaner units, track maintenance service members

items.text: New staff members will also included in this update. Now version 0.9 there will be some extra duty: players need to keep trains clean as well inside.
***THE MEGA-GIGA BIG PLANNED EXTRA!!***

notes.title: 11. Train interiors - might not arrive to 0.9 update still in alpha*

items.text: We plan to enable an amazing new feature you all will LOVE. When hovering over trains you will be able to see INSIDE the interiors of all your passenger train carriages including all chairs and small tables and you will be able to see when a train is getting full of passengers!
*Be warned that this features is highly in development so we cannot guarantee that this will be available in the next update fully. But working on it to make you all happy!! :)
All in all, the past few months was a bit quite without small updates so we plan to release the larger 0.9 huge update in the coming months!
Keep us updated with all your kind comments and suggestions and we still love to see all your creations in the screenshot section!
Created by user Marco

items.text: Hey Guys,
Finally we could have overcome an issue with updating so finally we have released the Build t435 update.
This is a major update containing lots of bug fixes and new features so it may contain some bugs for the first release:
1. Underpasses between platforms
2. Audio Localization: French
3. Graffiti Artists
4. Station Evacuation Button
5. Basic In-game tutorial
6. More transportation: parking lots, disabled person parking
7. More types of passengers: disabled passengers
8. Mobile phone Charging kiosk
9. Settings / Display - Force FULL HD Windowed mode

Finally we have enabled this highly requested feature so passengers can now cross longer tracks and platforms so no need to go around. This way you guys will be able to build much different station layouts so your passengers will be able to cross easily under tracks if they need to go to a toilette or any other facility nearby.

There was a discussion in one of the update comment sessions about the entrance of these underpasses. We have tested to move the stair entrances off the platforms but that caused some more complicated issues. We will create this week a detailed blog post of the "Insight of developing Train Station Simulator" and you will understand from that post why it was not possible to move the entrances off the platforms.
You can simple demolish the underpasses with the 2x5 demolish tool.
Finally we have updated the audio functions for our French users.

Gratified trains are finally here. Graffiti was is included in a simple way for now in Train Station Simulator. For this first version graffitis are appear on trains sometimes if there are too many vandals present in you station. In future version we may include more animation where you will be able see graffiti artists painting on trains.

We have enabled the Evacuation button on the right of the main down menu. You can evacuate your station any time and an alarm will sound and all your passengers will try to get to the closest emergency door and/or exit.
Right now unexpected threatens will not happen like bomb in a bag or flooding or any other situation but in the future we plan many many unexpected events that will effect your stations life.
If you click the Evacuation button again the alarm is stopped and everything turns back to normal.

We have enabled a short tutorial with basic tips on how to build your very first train station and how to setup your timetables and schedules. This is more useful for very newbie users and was a highly requested feature for long time.
Right now the tutorial is English only.

notes.title: 6. More transportation: parking lots, disabled person parking

items.text: We have enabled some more parking for cars and a disabled only parking spot.

notes.title: 7. More types of passengers: disabled passengers

items.text: If you would like to see more disabled passengers in your station you need to place a disabled parking.
Mobile phone Charging Kiosk is an eye candy so you make your station more colorful with facilities like this. Available in 2000 and 2010 all game modes.

notes.title: 9. Settings / Force FULL HD Windowed mode

items.text: In the settings/display you can use the FullHD Windowed mode that will set 1920x1080 window your game field that was requested as a quick fix for several monitor layouts (as the window size is generated from the screen resolution).
You may have noticed that some planned features have been left out from this update (disasters, tram lines). These features were moved back on the list to enable certain more important quick fixes.
Thank you for your help guys, hope to get more fun soon to Train Station Simulator!!
